newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia to spend A$600mln on small business.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia to spend A$600mln on small business.

text.p: The Australian government's package of measures to support small business will cost more than A$600 million in its first four years of operation, Prime Minister John Howard said on Monday.
"The overall package involves reforms to business taxation and regulatory programmes at a cost of over A$600 million over four years," Howard told parliament in announcing the measures.
The estimates did not include the creation of a Small Business Innovation Fund, which Howard also announced on Friday. The fund would cost A$130 million over four years, the statement said.
Howard's statement showed that the full-year cost of the measures would be about A$200 million a year.
The most expensive measure was a loosening of capital gains tax obligations for retiring small business operators, which would cost A$90 million a year once it started in 1998/99.
